correctness.rationale: For every n≥1 all 2^(n−1) ordered positive compositions are equally weighted; k=1 gives L=B=0 and k=2 gives B=L once. Disjoint edge-pair enumeration establishes H=2[Q+2J/(1−W)+P²/(1−W)²], F=2P/(1−W)² and G=2P/(1−W) at t=z/2. Independently rederived P,Q and checked J from h_a against its formal series; exact symbolic reduction reproduced all three displayed rational functions. Subtraction of the pole parts H=(8/9)/(1−z)²−(620/189)/(1−z)+H0, F=(2/3)/(1−z)²−(22/9)/(1−z)+F0, G=(4/3)/(1−z)+G0 yields c_n=−4/189+residual. Independently factored all H0,F0,G0 denominators, whose zeros have |z|=2, and recomputed the explicit |z|=3/2 coefficient bounds. Their common n=100 bound is below 4/189 and decreases for n≥100. Independent rational recurrences checked all n=1..100 and full direct enumeration all 2^(n−1) compositions for 2≤n≤15. This proves exact zero at n=1,2, strict positive 3..14, strict negative n≥15, with exact c14=1745/2097152, c15=−551287/67108864 and limiting −4/189; finite checks are combined with a genuine analytic infinite tail argument.
residual_risks: The analytic sign proof relies on the all-n combinatorial factorization and exact coefficient pole subtraction; these were reconstructed and tested, not externally formally certified.
All-size claim is limited to strictly positive ordered integer compositions with a uniform distribution; the two-part seam is counted once.

value.rationale: The closing edge B is an intrinsic boundary-closure statistic for a linear composition and changes the variation geometry in a mathematically motivated way. The exact change from positive boundary–bulk covariance for 3≤n≤14 to negative covariance for every n≥15, together with a nonzero limiting constant despite growth of the linear variation, provides a sharp previously unreported structural dependence law, not merely a moment formula, arbitrary slice, or numerical sign observation. The exact threshold and limit can be reused in random composition/bargraph boundary dependence calculations.
residual_risks: Sign reversal is a specialized invariant of the uniform model; no broader universality or general correlated-composition theorem follows.
The mathematical value does not itself prove bibliographic novelty.

limitations: Only uniform positive ordered integer compositions and absolute first differences are covered; seam counted once at k=2.
All-size sign and limit follow from the combinatorial rational proof and analytic bounds; finite computations alone would not prove them.
Novelty is best-of-knowledge: possible uninspected generalized endpoint-marked bargraph transfer-matrix formula remains an originality risk.
